extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax payable before grant of probate
extracted.summary: An executor in Harrogate seeks about £61,000 to pay inheritance tax on a largely illiquid estate worth around £390,000 so that the grant of probate can be issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the background on your late father's estate. To take this further we would need a copy of the will naming you as executor, the death certificate, the draft estate accounts or an asset and liability schedule, a valuation for the Harrogate property and details of any mortgage or charge on it, and the HMRC inheritance tax calculation showing the amount due and the date it falls due. It would also help to have written confirmation from Yardley Solicitors that they are instructed, along with their contact details, and confirmation of whether any other executors or beneficiaries are involved. Once we have those documents a member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or legal advice.
